plan.summary: Fix race condition in next_id() by using file-based locking when generating new IDs
plan.approach: Use filelock (already available via transitive dependency) to protect the load-compute-save cycle in TodoApp.add()

tdd_sequence.description: Create failing regression test that spawns multiple processes calling app.add() concurrently and asserts unique IDs
Add file-based locking to TodoStorage using filelock library, protecting the critical section around load/next_id/save
Run targeted tests and linting to ensure fix works and code quality is maintained

implementation_details.strategy: Add a lock method to TodoStorage that uses filelock with a .lock file alongside the database. The add operation in cli.py will acquire this lock during the load-compute-next_id-save cycle.
key_changes: Add import for filelock in storage.py
Add acquire_lock() context manager method to TodoStorage
Modify TodoApp.add() to use locking around the critical section

alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Requires additional file or restructuring JSON format; more invasive change
Only detects after the fact; does not prevent duplicates from being created

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py tests/test_issue_5213_next_id_race_condition.py
acceptance_criteria: Two concurrent add operations produce different IDs

implementation.actual_approach: Used fcntl.flock (built-in Unix file locking) instead of filelock library
key_changes_made: Added _lock_path() method to get lock file path
Added _file_lock() context manager using fcntl.flock for cross-process sync
Added add_todo_atomic() method that holds lock during entire add operation
Updated TodoApp.add() to use the new atomic method
Created comprehensive regression tests for concurrent ID generation

risks: Uses fcntl.flock which is Unix-only (not available on Windows)
Lock file (.todo.json.lock) is created alongside the data file
Lock is process-level, not thread-level (multiprocessing safe but may need consideration for threaded environments)
commit_message: fix: add file locking to prevent duplicate IDs in concurrent next_id()
